description: This file defines the ModuleNode class in Twig, representing a module node in the templating system. It includes methods for constructing, compiling, and rendering template modules, handling traits, blocks, macros, and inheritance logic.

classes.name: ModuleNode
classes.description: Represents a Twig module node, encapsulating the structure and behavior for compiling and rendering template modules, including handling inheritance, blocks, macros, and traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ModuleNode with body, parent, blocks, macros, traits, embedded templates, and source context.

methods.name: setIndex
methods.description: Sets the index attribute for the node, used during compilation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the module node into PHP code using the provided Compiler object.

methods.name: compileTemplate
methods.description: Generates the PHP code for the template class, including class header, constructor, parent loader, display logic, and footer.

methods.name: compileGetParent
methods.description: Generates code to determine and return the parent template for inheritance.

methods.name: compileClassHeader
methods.description: Generates the PHP class header, including the class declaration and necessary use statements.

methods.name: compileConstructor
methods.description: Generates the constructor method for the template class, including traits and blocks initialization.

methods.name: compileDisplay
methods.description: Generates the doDisplay method responsible for rendering the template content.

methods.name: compileClassFooter
methods.description: Generates the closing brackets for the class definition.

methods.name: compileMacros
methods.description: Generates code for macros defined in the template.

methods.name: compileGetTemplateName
methods.description: Generates method to return the template's name.

methods.name: compileIsTraitable
methods.description: Generates code to determine if the template can be used as a trait.

methods.name: compileDebugInfo
methods.description: Generates the method to return debug information for the template.

methods.name: compileGetSourceContext
methods.description: Generates method to return the source context of the template.

methods.name: compileLoadTemplate
methods.description: Loads a template trait, only accepting constant expressions.
